title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India

rules.heading: Declarations to be made on every package
rules.text: Every package shall bear thereon or on label securely affixed thereto, a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration made in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter.

subrules.heading: Name and address of manufacturer, packer, or importer
subrules.text: The name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer and for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be declared on the package.

subrules.heading: Generic name or identity of the commodity
subrules.text: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product shall be specified on the package.

subrules.heading: Net quantity declaration
subrules.text: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned.

subrules.heading: Date of manufacture, packing, or import
subrules.text: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned in the package.

subrules.heading: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
subrules.text: The retail sale price of the package in the form of Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes in Indian currency shall be clearly declared.

subrules.heading: Consumer care and complaints contact details
subrules.text: The name, address, telephone number, e-mail address, if available, of the person who can be or the office which can be contacted, in case of consumer complaints shall be stated.

subrules.heading: Country of origin
subrules.text: The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package.

rules.heading: Manner in which declaration shall be made
rules.text: (1) Every declaration which is required to be made on a package under these rules shall be legible and prominent. (2) The declaration of net quantity shall be in terms of standard metric units.

subrules.heading: Legibility and prominence of declarations
subrules.text: Every declaration which is required to be made on a package under these rules shall be legible and prominent.

subrules.heading: Standard metric units requirement
subrules.text: The declaration of net quantity shall be in terms of standard metric units of weight, measure or number.

rules.heading: Provisions relating to wholesale dealer and retail dealer
rules.text: (1) No wholesale dealer or retail dealer shall sell, distribute, deliver, display or offer for sale any commodity in packed form at a price exceeding the retail sale price thereof.

subrules.heading: Prohibition of selling above Maximum Retail Price
subrules.text: No wholesale dealer or retail dealer shall sell, distribute, deliver, display or offer for sale any commodity in packed form at a price exceeding the retail sale price thereof.
